integrity: Proof covers all integer n>=2 and treats B=n+1 separately. Finite program checks are distinct from infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Uniform iid coupon types only. Holst (1986) unified urn report was not inspected in full, and implicit priority coverage is possible. The displayed covariance and regression properties have no independent audit.
title: First-collision versus full-collection times: exact negative regression and a Rayleigh covariance scale
